text:
release-manager: Quick sync — built offline/airgap package epoch v2.4.1 for Private/VPC. Packaging finished but we have a signer/KMS rotation scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Two options: ship now with short-lived signed submanifest + emergency rollback plan, or hold until rotation completes. Deploy window for customers is 08:00-10:00 UTC — need decision and explicit fallback before I hand off to transport ops.

olga: Thanks. Do we know which customers will be affected if signer TTL overlaps?

release-manager: Looks like two large tenants (ACME & NovaPay) have delivery windows during 08:00-09:00 UTC. If we rotate signer in-flight some clients' transport will reject manifests until we republish signed submanifests.

samir: can we issue a short-lived signer and pin the epoch id on the installer? i.e., publish both signed-manifest:v2.4.1 and signed-manifest:v2.4.1-ephemeral then instruct ops to prefer ephemeral during handoff.

maria: If we go ephemeral we must ensure offline installer verifies cosign sigs against both keys. Current installer only accepts a single key thumbprint. That needs a patch and new shrinkwrap.

aj: Is patching installer for dual-thumbprint verification a 30m change or a day?

maria: ~2-3 hours dev + 30m QA + new shrinkwrap. Tight for today.

release-manager: Options summary: (A) Hold packaging until rotation completes -> customers later than planned, but simplest. (B) Ship now with ephemeral signed-manifest + manual ops checklist to republish on rotation -> riskier, needs extra steps. (C) Ship with fallback: pin to previous stable release (v2.4.0) if verification fails -> requires clear rollback script in transport.

olga: I prefer C. Safer to let customer deploy then automatically fallback to v2.4.0 if cosign verification fails. How fast can transport fallback run?

pkg-bot: incoming: preflight checks — all artifacts checksummed, cosign: OK, manifest-hash: OK, shrinkwrap: OK.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-hosts=3 region=us-west1 -> start=5771234575 status=queued

samir: For C we'll need two things in the handoff doc: 1) a transport fallback script that swaps manifest pointer to v2.4.0 and 2) a signed, preloaded v2.4.0 manifest in the escort store so it's immediate. I can draft both.

maria: Also add this quick verify command for ops to run post-handoff:

```
cosign verify --key <kms://projects/xxx/keys/packaging> signed-manifest-v2.4.1.tar.gz
sha256sum signed-manifest-v2.4.1.tar.gz
```

release-manager: Good. Add explicit TTLs: ephemeral signer validity 2 hours max. If ephemeral used - ops must rotate manifest pointer before TTL expiry or trigger fallback.

olga: What about customers with strict airgap windows? We can't force them to re-download.

aj: For those customers, we should prefer to hold. Which customers are strict? release-manager: ACME is strict. NovaPay is flexible.

release-manager: Proposal: For ACME we hold packaging until rotation completes (no change). For other tenants we proceed with option C: ship with pinned fallback. This hybrid reduces risk.

maria: ack — I'll start preparing a patch branch for dual-thumbprint, but move that to next minor. It won't block the hybrid plan.

samir: Drafting fallback script now. Will post short checklist in this thread when ready.

pkg-bot: verify: transport-store contains signed-manifest:v2.4.0 preloaded -> true

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary-hosts=3 region=us-west1 -> status=running start_ts=5771234578

release-manager: Ops checklist (high level):
- Pin ACME package: hold and schedule delivery post-rotation
- For others: publish signed-manifest:v2.4.1 and signed-manifest:v2.4.1-fallback -> both in escort store
- Ensure transport fallback script located at /opt/transport/bin/fallback-manifest.sh and executable
- Validate cosign key thumbprint in handoff doc (both old and ephemeral)
- Post-handshake: monitor canaries for 15m, fallback if >5% verification failures

samir: checklist uploaded: /releases/hand-offs/5771234567-fallback-checklist.md (ops-aware diff included). Short snippet of fallback script: 

```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
CURRENT_MANIFEST=$1
FALLBACK="signed-manifest-v2.4.0.tar.gz"
# quick swap
ln -f /escort/manifests/$FALLBACK /escort/manifests/current
systemctl restart escort-serve || true
logger "manifest swapped to $FALLBACK"
```

olga: nice. Add alertation to PagerDuty if swap runs.

release-manager: Decision (hybrid): hold ACME; proceed for rest with fallback pinned to v2.4.0. Signer ephemeral only if absolutely needed and limited to 2h. Maria to own installer patch backlog. Samir to own fallback script & ops doc. Ops to run canary and report in 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary update: canary-hosts=3 region=us-west1 -> status=healthy elapsed=12m success_rate=100%

maria: cheers. I'll update shrinkwrap metadata to include fallback pointer and cosign thumbprint block.

release-manager: Thanks everyone. I'll push handoff and tag transport ops. @olga @samir please confirm once ACME hold is scheduled. :thumbsup:

olga: scheduled in calendar — hold noted. :white_check_mark:

samir: fallback script + doc posted and linked to the handoff. :thumbsup:

pkg-bot: final preflight: all checks green, release bundle size 1.2GB, checksums attached.

release-manager: Closing thread — proceeding with hybrid plan. Will open follow-up to track installer patch for dual-thumbprint.
